race.title: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: The pick of KADASTRAL 's novice hurdle form reads well (twice second behind one who finished runner-up in Grade 1 company) and having undergone a breathing operation following his Uttoxeter disappointment in the spring, Dan Skelton's 6-y-o firmly appeals as the type to do better now his attentions switch to larger obstacles. A pace duel won't help either C&D winner Sans Bruit or Javert Allen but both are too well handicapped to ignore. Conquer The Breeze is interesting at forecast longer odds. KADASTRAL (FR) SANS BRUIT (FR) JAVERT ALLEN (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Kadastral (11/8), Javert Allen (9/2), Sans Bruit (5/1), Ballybreeze (12/1), Coup De Coeur (12/1), Bleu D'enfer (14/1), Conquer The Breeze (14/1), Sir Tivo (16/1), Petit Tonnerre (20/1), Cossack Chach (25/1), Cobbler's Boy (50/1)
